what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Russia, as counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 578 people displaced by conflict and violence.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, and armed conflict over the government of Russia in 2023 and 2024.
IDMC's disaster records for Russia list floods, storms, wildfires, earthquakes and mass movements.

when.text: IDMC's figures rose from 80000 in 2009 to 170517 in 2024, the main year of displacement in the data.
For 2013, IDMC estimated 34900 IDPs while UNHCR's file shows none.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 2653 new displacements by conflict and violence and 3622 by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Russia.

bad_numbers: when: 3 numbers in this part (at most 2; years don't count)
